## Summary

Lands the schema + provider abstraction + library shell for the creative-render pipeline (Canva Autofill, Bannerbear, Placid). All three live providers are stubs gated behind their own \`FEATURE_*\` flags. Manual templates work today; live-rendering is a single env-var flip per provider once the corresponding account/approval clears.

## Schema (migration 031)

- \`creative_templates\` — per-user template registry. Provider whitelist: \`canva\` | \`bannerbear\` | \`placid\` | \`manual\`. Channel: \`feed\` | \`story\` | \`reel\` | \`display\` | \`other\`. \`fields_jsonb\` stores the variable schema so the autofill UI knows which inputs to show.
- \`creative_renders\` — per-render history. Status walks \`queued → rendering → done | failed\`. \`provider_job_id\` is the polling handle.
- Standard RLS, indexes (incl. partial index on in-flight renders), \`updated_at\` triggers, \`notify pgrst\`.

## Provider abstraction (\`lib/creatives/\`)

- \`types.ts\` — \`CreativeProvider\` interface (\`listTemplates\`, \`render\`, \`pollRender\`), \`CreativeProviderDisabledError\`, \`CanvaPendingEnterpriseError\` (typed subclass), per-provider \`isXEnabled()\` helpers.
- \`canva/provider.ts\` — STUB. Throws \`CanvaPendingEnterpriseError\` when flag off. When flag on but unimplemented, throws a clear TODO error.
- \`bannerbear/provider.ts\` — STUB behind \`FEATURE_BANNERBEAR\`.
- \`placid/provider.ts\` — STUB behind \`FEATURE_PLACID\`.
- \`manual/provider.ts\` — works today (no flag). \`render\` returns \`status: done\` with null asset_url so the user can populate the URL manually.
- \`registry.ts\` — \`getCreativeProvider(name)\` lookup.

## DB helpers (\`lib/db/creative-templates.ts\`)

\`listCreativeTemplatesForUser\` and \`listCreativeRendersForEvent\`. Same \`AnySupabaseClient\` cast pattern as \`lib/db/ticketing.ts\` — drop after Matas regens types post-migration.

## UI

The page resolves cleanly with the migration not applied — \`listCreativeTemplatesForUser\` returns an empty array on table-missing errors via the existing \`console.warn\`-and-fallback pattern.

body:
## Summary
- New `/daily` page rendering cards from the public `danharris923.github.io/canadadealsdaily/deals.json` feed, using the site's brand-navy/brand-blue + savings-green tokens (matches `/deals` layout).
- `src/lib/deal-feed.ts` — ETag-aware server fetch via Next.js ISR (`revalidate: 3600`), strict field coercion, and upfront filtering of records missing the `tag=f10a7654-20` affiliate tag (warn-logged so we notice upstream drift).
- `src/components/DealFeedCard.tsx` + `src/components/DealFeedFilters.tsx` — card with lazy img, `image → image_source → null` fallback, SR-only price text, and URL-param-driven category/min-discount filters.
- `scripts/smoke-deal-feed.mjs` — zero-dep Node smoke test asserting at least one renderable record carries `tag=f10a7654-20`.

## Outbound-link compliance
All card anchors use `target="_blank" rel="sponsored nofollow noopener"` per FTC + SEO + tab-hijack hardening requirements.

## Constraints respected
- No modification to `main_affiliate_url` at render time — records without the tag are dropped, not rewritten. The feed's tag is already baked in upstream; this site does not run its own `normalizeDeal` pipeline, so there is no existing rewrite hook to sidestep.
- No proxy/mirror of the feed; fetched directly so the GitHub Pages cache layer is shared across all three sister sites.
- No new runtime dependencies; smoke test runs via plain `node`.
- No `/stores/*` routes added (sister-site constraint — unchanged).

## ⚠️ Upstream feed not yet live
At PR-open time the feed URL returns 404 — the first scrape is in progress. The smoke test will fail until it publishes; once it does, run:

```
node scripts/smoke-deal-feed.mjs
```

and `/daily` will populate automatically (ISR, no redeploy).

## Test plan
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Once feed is live: `node scripts/smoke-deal-feed.mjs` prints `ok — N/M renderable cards carry tag=f10a7654-20`
- [ ] Visit `/daily` — cards render, images lazy-load, keyboard `Tab` focuses each card, screen reader announces "sale price \$X, was \$Y"
- [ ] Filter by category and drag min-discount slider — URL updates, grid re-renders
- [ ] Set filters that match nothing — empty state shows link back to `/daily`
- [ ] Click a card — opens in new tab, DevTools shows `rel="sponsored nofollow noopener"`

* api-change:``rds``: [``botocore``] Adds a new DescribeServerlessV2PlatformVersions API to describe platform version properties for Aurora Serverless v2. Also introduces a new valid maintenance action value for serverless platform version updates.
* bugfix:signing: [``botocore``] Fix bug so that configured auth scheme preference is used when auth scheme is resolved from endpoints rulesets, or from operation-level auth trait. Auth scheme preference can be configured using the existing ``auth_scheme_preference`` client config option, the ``auth_scheme_preference`` shared config setting, or the existing ``AWS_AUTH_SCHEME_PREFERENCE`` environment v

## Summary

Fill the §17.7 gap at the explicit-named-theorem level:

**Finite-volume (`IsingModel/PhaseTransition.lean`):**
- `zeta_nonneg_finite_vol`: `truncated4 G ⟨J, 0, β⟩ i j k l ≤ 0` for pairwise-distinct sites (ferromagnetic, `h = 0`). Explicit name wrapping `cor_4_3_3`.

**∞-volume (`IsingModel/AmbientLattice.lean` extension):**
- `eta_nonneg_infinite_vol`: `0 ≤ truncated2Infinite G Λ p i j` (ferromagnetic). Wrapping `truncated2Infinite_nonneg`.
- `zeta_nonneg_infinite_vol`: `truncated4Infinite G Λ ⟨J, 0, β⟩ i j k l ≤ 0` for pairwise-distinct sites. Wrapping `truncated4Infinite_nonpos_h_zero`.

**ℤ^d wrappers:**
- `eta_nonneg_infinite_vol_latticeGraph`, `zeta_nonneg_{finite,infinite}_vol_latticeGraph`.

All are thin pass-throughs of existing inequalities. No new proofs, no sorry.

## Why

§17.7 row in docs/index.md marks η ≥ 0, ζ ≥ 0 Done "via Cor 4.3.3". This PR adds explicit named theorems `zeta_nonneg_finite_vol` and ∞-vol variants matching `eta_nonneg_finite_vol`'s pattern, making the §17.7 API complete and uniform.
